hooks.name: Banned source guard
hooks.description: Fails if a banned data source or web3 import appears in app, lib, or components.

action.command: grep -rnE "vxtwitter|bsc-dataseed1|check-by-addresses|etherscan\.io/api|api\.bscscan|from ['\"](ethers|viem|web3)" app lib components && { echo 'Banned source or web3 import found (see .kiro/steering/tech.md)' >&2; exit 1; } || exit 0
